new_tests.purpose: Validate deterministic 30/50/100 fault/failover artifact bundles, missing semantics, unsafe scope rejection, P14 real-evidence rejection, and cross-artifact consistency.
Add process-runtime primary-stop scope tests proving shared nodehost containers are not stopped for one logical Valkey primary.
Verify 30/50/100 fault, failover, workload, and cleanup coverage is sourced from L08 machine-readable artifacts while scale-build coverage remains intact.
Verify rendered report indexes include fault_failover_scale.json as a source artifact and expose L08 summary text.
CI guard for L08 audit command, schema validation, workflow ordering, command-log P14 boundary, and safety invariants.
Verify provenance graph includes L08 fault/failover rollup and canonical source artifact edges.

new_artifact_checks: All 30/50/100 L08 source artifacts exist and are JSON-valid.
Each source artifact records producer, run_id, phase_id, node_count, status, and source path consistency.

Real evidence requires producer scripts/fault_failover_gate.py, real_valkey true, Valkey 9.1.x versions, exact before-fault node count, expected during-fault node count semantics, promotion observed, and cleanup PASS.
Fault reports require safety checks with host_network_mutated false, global_firewall_mutated false, sandbox_only true, fault_apply_latency_ms, fault_clear_latency_ms, and owned target scope.
Workload windows require before_fault, during_fault, and after_recovery entries with operation counts, availability, errors, timeouts, and latency summaries or explicit missing markers.
Split-brain metrics require direct indicators or explicit MISSING reason.
P14/1000 real fault/failover artifacts are blocking findings and cannot count as coverage.
L08 command log latest real gate rows require --require-data-path and positive elapsed duration.
Repository-local cache and scratch artifacts (__pycache__, .pyc, .pytest_cache, _fault_failover_work_*) are absent.

acceptance_criteria: The L08 deterministic harness catches missing artifacts, unsafe scope, fake evidence, P14 real evidence, missing workload windows, and invented metrics.
The real wrapper produces canonical 30/50/100 artifact bundles or the stage records a genuine BLOCKED resource-preflight result and does not mark PASS.
Process-runtime primary stop targets only the selected logical Valkey PID inside an owned nodehost container.
All missing or skipped metrics are explicit and reasoned.
Coverage and report views are generated from machine-readable source artifacts only.
P14 remains dry-run-only with no real 1000-node fault/failover execution.
Review, validation, and anti-regression agents approve before commit.
